body:
PR #9 is open for review (stacked on PR #8 `product/fix-29b`): https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/9 (`0aeae5b3c1abcc69712a3b48351d278a7b3e1ef5`).

Implements STORY-79 / ADR-81:
- Dep-info (`*.d`) + workspace `src/`/`tests/`/`benches/`/`examples/`/`Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`/`build.rs` mtime freshness check (`fresh_check`) before entering the slot queue.
- Single-flight `$dir/fresh.lock` (non-blocking `flock -n $ffd`) so at most one fresh-bypass build runs off-slot at a time; a 2nd concurrent fresh build falls through to slot 0.
- Slow-test gate (`AIDA_CARGO_FRESH_MAX_RUN_S=60`) so `cargo test` with previous `run_s > 60s` queues normally.
- JSONL `"slot":"none"`, `"reason":"fresh"` / `"fresh-miss"` telemetry and `cargo log --stats` (`(N fresh-skips, M fresh-misses)` + `--by reason`).
- Also filters out transient forked bash subshells whose `ppid` is itself a live wrapper in `cargo-ps` and `cargo-log`.
- All 24 test sections pass (`ALL PASS`). Proceeding to PR #10 (`STORY-80`) and PR #11 (`BUG-83`) in `/home/joe/ai/aida-host-wip` next.
subject: READY FOR REVIEW: aida-host PR #9 (0aeae5b) — STORY-79 fresh build bypass
